newsitem.title: HONG KONG: PRESS DIGEST - HK newspaper headlines - Dec 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - HK newspaper headlines - Dec 16.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Hong Kong press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

-- HONG KONG ECONOMIC TIMES -- China's chief representative to the Sino-British Land Commission, Chen Rongchun, said increasing land supply may not be able to curb rising property prices. His remarks are opposed to those of Chief Executive-designate Tung Chee-hwa.

-- SOUTH CHINA MORNING POST -- There was anger last night after it was suggested by a mainland official that the Selection Committee might undertake functions not outlined in the Joint Declaration and the Basic Law.

-- HONG KONG STANDARD -- Up to 60 people were injured when a giant freight ship owned by COSCO Hong Kong slammed into a crowded shopping mall and hotel on the banks of the Mississippi River in New Orleans.
-- MING PAO DAILY -- Britain's Prince Andrew will embark on a three-day visit to Hong Kong on Monday. During his tour, he will meet Governor Chris Patten and the British Garrison.

-- SING PAO DAILY -- A street poll conducted by a women's concern group revealed only 45 percent of respondents knew the existence of the Equal Opportunities Commission and the Sex Discrimination Ordinance. Nearly half of the respondents said they had experienced discrimination.
